AcceptLendOffer.description:
The borrower's answer to a Lend Offer (#258): the copies taken per line ("0" leaves a line out; the rest is
released) and one of their Decks for the cards (None for Unsorted).
AcceptLendOffer.title: AcceptLendOffer

AskForMoreTime.description: The later return-by date the borrower asks for (#256).
AskForMoreTime.title: AskForMoreTime

AttributeValues.description: Card attributes. In a report or correction, null means "not stated"; in effective attributes, unknown.
AttributeValues.title: AttributeValues

BlockedCollector.description:
One Block in Settings › Privacy: ``block_id`` addresses Unblock. ``handle`` is set only when the blocker already
knew it (``block.handle_shown``), ``trader_id`` only for a Block made by trader id. No user id.
BlockedCollector.title: BlockedCollector

BlockedList.description: Settings › Privacy: the signed-in collector's Blocks, by name; no user id.
BlockedList.title: BlockedList

BorrowedCard.description:
Borrowed Copies of one Card Edition from one Loan in one of the collector's own Locations: the Borrowed entry's
row. ``lender``: the lender's Display Name.
BorrowedCard.title: BorrowedCard

BorrowedCopies.description: Every Borrowed Copy the collector holds, by Location name, then card; ``copies`` sums them.
BorrowedCopies.title: BorrowedCopies

CardHolder.description:
A collector with one card for trade (card search). Never carries a user id or a Handle. ``band`` is null for a
Friend. ``cards``: up to ``CARDS_PER_HOLDER`` of their matching Editions, ``more_cards`` the rest.
CardHolder.title: CardHolder

CardMatches.description: Friends' copies of one Card Printing (the card popup), under the viewer's ``printings`` choice.
CardMatches.title: CardMatches

CatalogCheck.description: The newest scheduled change check (#340; owner only, collector responses never carry it).
CatalogCheck.title: CatalogCheck

ChangeReturnBy.description: The lender's new return-by date (#256), or None to clear it.
ChangeReturnBy.title: ChangeReturnBy

CollectionImportChange.description:
One change, with exactly one action. `pick`, `finish`, `skip` and `restore` apply to rows: by `rows` (row
numbers) or `filter` (the rows route's filter, as it stands when this change applies), exactly one of them.
`group` with `include` (#232) leaves one of the file's groups out (false) or brings it back (true), and
`location_id` (#232) moves the landing Storage Leaf; neither names rows. Unknown fields are refused, so an older
API never ignores a newer change.
CollectionImportChange.title: CollectionImportChange

CollectionImportGroup.description: One of the file's groups (#232): a portfolio, folder or list, never a Location.
CollectionImportGroup.title: CollectionImportGroup

CollectionImportLeftOut.description: The rows the filters left out for one reason (#231): never listed, counted or saved.
CollectionImportLeftOut.title: CollectionImportLeftOut

CollectionImportPick.description:
The card a row is: exactly one of a Printing (the row's finish then chooses its Edition, as matching does) or one
of its active Editions.
CollectionImportPick.title: CollectionImportPick

CollectionImportSource.description: What the collector's file said, from the columns PrizeCheck reads; "" for a blank cell.
CollectionImportSource.title: CollectionImportSource

Collector.description:
Another collector as Friends screens show them: the Display Name and Handle. ``collector_id`` addresses
commands and is never shown.
Collector.title: Collector

CombinedRow.description: One card of the combined total, with the Decks that need it, oldest first.
CombinedRow.title: CombinedRow

ConfirmSwap.description:
Confirm swap. ``destination_id``: one of the confirmer's own Storage Leaves or Decks for the cards they get, or
None for Unsorted; ignored when they get none. ``deck_switches``: the switches the collector left ticked, each as
the side read offered it, with at most its count.
ConfirmSwap.title: ConfirmSwap

ConfirmedSwap.description:
The confirmer's own answer to Confirm swap: the Trade as they read it, plus the Decks their chosen switches
changed. Only ever answered to the confirmer under ``/api/trades``; ``TradeView`` itself never names a Deck.
ConfirmedSwap.title: ConfirmedSwap

ConversationParty.description:
The other collector as the reader sees them in a conversation. ``trader_id`` is their address for messages
(None once their account is deleted); ``handle`` is set for Friends only; ``band`` is the distance band (None
unless both are in open discovery, and None when they are unavailable); ``completed_trades`` is None when they
are unavailable. Never their collector id.
ConversationParty.title: ConversationParty

ConversationPulse.description:
What the web polls: how many visible conversations are unread, and an opaque watermark that changes when
anything the shell shows may have changed.
ConversationPulse.title: ConversationPulse

ConversationSummary.description:
One row of the conversation list. ``open_trades``: Trades not closed. ``waiting_on_you``: those that wait on the
reader. ``unread``: the other side wrote since the reader last read. ``archived``: hidden until newer activity.
ConversationSummary.title: ConversationSummary

ConversationView.description:
A conversation and its newest page of items (newest first), or an empty one (``id`` None) for a Friend the
reader has not written to. ``status``: 'open', 'you_blocked' (the reader blocked the other) or 'unavailable' (the
other blocked the reader, is suspended or is deleted; the three read alike). ``can_message`` and ``can_propose``:
the conversation is open and the reader is not suspended. ``can_report``: the other collector still exists.
``next_before`` is the cursor of the next, older page.
ConversationView.title: ConversationView

ConversationsView.description:
One page of the list, newest activity first. ``next_before``: the cursor of the next page. ``suspended``: the
reader is suspended (the Trades tab says so).
ConversationsView.title: ConversationsView

CountedFromDeck.description: Copies another Deck holds for its own line that this line counts (One Deck at a time only).
CountedFromDeck.title: CountedFromDeck

CounterTrade.description:
A Counter (Trading #278): the countered proposal's revision and a key, then the reply's own lines and cash,
from the counterer's side, as a send names them.
CounterTrade.title: CounterTrade

disclaimer.default: Basic deck checks only. Format legality, including rotation and banned cards, is reported by the advisory format checks.
disclaimer.title: Disclaimer

DeckCostFigures.description: One cost figure over a set of copies, with the same statuses, counts and labels as the top-level fields.
DeckCostFigures.title: DeckCostFigures

disclaimer.default: Advisory format checks: a result is not a guarantee of tournament legality. Missing rules or card data makes a result unknown, never legal.
disclaimer.title: Disclaimer

DeckIndexCover.description:
The card a Deck's tile is led by (#291): the collector's pick, or else the line with the most copies (ties: a
Pokémon, then the first name). Display data only; never priced or evaluated.
DeckIndexCover.title: DeckIndexCover

DeckIndexEntry.description:
One Deck on the Decks index (app redesign #181): its place in the Location tree plus what its row shows.

``deck_list_total`` is the copies on its Deck List, ``in_deck`` how many of those this Deck holds (per line, the
lesser of the line and the Deck's Holding), and ``target_format`` its Deck List's Target Format. The result in that
Format and the cost to complete come from the Deck's own format-checks and cost reads, which the page asks for row
by row, so this read never evaluates a Deck or prices anything while it holds the owner lock. The cover comes from the Deck's
cover pick and Deck List lines plus catalog display data, so the read still never evaluates or prices.
DeckIndexEntry.title: DeckIndexEntry

DeckLoanLine.description:
What Loans take of one Card Edition in this Deck (social network #252 and #253, spec "Lender-side data"):
``reserved``, copies the Loan Pick List takes from here and still in the Deck ("2 reserved for Kim"), and ``lent``,
copies handed over from here and out with a Friend ("3 lent to Sam"), each oldest Loan first. Reserved copies stay
in the Deck and count for it until handover; lent copies are missing from it but never on the Want List.
``borrowed`` (#254): the Borrowed Copies in this Deck, by lender ("1 from Ash K."); they fill the Deck's lines.
DeckLoanLine.title: DeckLoanLine

DiscoverCost.description: The deck's cost from cached quotes only (base-10 strings, like the Published Deck cost).
DiscoverCost.title: DiscoverCost

DiscoverySettings.description:
The caller's own Open discovery setting: its status, their zip code, the radius they search, the zip changes they
have left in the last 24 hours and whether collectors who are not their Friends can see them.
DiscoverySettings.title: DiscoverySettings

EditDeck.description: Rename a Deck, move it to another parent, or both. The fields and rules are the Location edit's.
EditDeck.title: EditDeck

FriendCard.description:
One Card Edition a Friend could lend now. ``spare`` and ``in_deck`` are copies: loose or beyond a Deck's own
line, and held by a Deck for its own line. ``wanted``: it matches a card the viewer's Want List still needs.
FriendCard.title: FriendCard

FriendCollection.description: One page of a Friend's Collection. ``collector_id`` addresses the Friend in commands and is never shown.
FriendCollection.title: FriendCollection

FriendCommandResult.description: How the two collectors stand after the command.
FriendCommandResult.title: FriendCommandResult

FriendCopy.description:
One Friend's copies of one Card Edition that matches what the viewer asked about. ``other_printing``: the
Edition is of another Card Printing of the wanted card's Reprint Group, so its set and number are worth showing.
``collector_id`` addresses the Friend in commands (Ask to borrow, #252) and is never shown.
FriendCopy.title: FriendCopy

FriendTradeCard.description: One Card Edition on a Friend's Trade List. ``copies``: how many they offer now.
FriendTradeCard.title: FriendTradeCard

FriendTradeList.description:
One page of a Friend's Trade List. ``collector_id`` addresses the Friend in commands and is never shown.
``trader_id`` is the Friend's address on the trader routes and in the builder; never shown.
``completed_trades``: the Friend's completed Trades (Trading #298), always a number for a Friend.
FriendTradeList.title: FriendTradeList

FriendsView.description:
The Friends drawer: Friend Requests received (oldest first), Friends (by name) and requests sent (oldest
first).
FriendsView.title: FriendsView

ImportDeckResult.description: The new Deck's Location node and inventory revision (as Create Deck answers) with the Deck List command result.
ImportDeckResult.title: ImportDeckResult

ImportEdition.description: One active Edition of the line's Printing, in catalog order, for the Edition chooser.
ImportEdition.title: ImportEdition

ImportFix.description: One collector choice for one card line: exactly one of ``drop``, ``printing_id`` and ``edition_id``.
ImportFix.title: ImportFix

ImportKept.description: Copies of the line's card another Deck keeps, so the import leaves them alone (Every Deck built at once).
ImportKept.title: ImportKept

ImportPart.description: Copies of one Card Edition that one pasted line becomes.
ImportPart.title: ImportPart

ImportPlace.description:
Where owned copies are: a Location, or a Deck (its copies beyond its own list, or under One Deck at a time the
copies it holds for its own list).
ImportPlace.title: ImportPlace

ImportPublication.description:
The Published Deck a Copy review read (#216): the new Deck's default name and Target Format, and the snapshot
version the screen pins.
ImportPublication.title: ImportPublication

ImportReplace.description: What saving a Replace sends and what it leaves behind, read with the owned copies under the owner row lock.
ImportReplace.title: ImportReplace

ImportSource.description:
Exactly one of ``text`` (a pasted list) and ``publication`` (a Published Deck's token: Copy to my Decks, #216);
anything else answers 422 INVALID_SOURCE.
ImportSource.title: ImportSource

InboxIds.description: The updates the drawer showed, by ``InboxUpdate.id``.
InboxIds.title: InboxIds

InboxTradeUpdate.description:
One Trade update under **Earlier**. ``id`` names it to the read and clear routes, as a Loan update's does.
``other_name``: the collector who took the step, as the Trade names them. ``trade_state`` and ``role`` (the
reader's side) let the screen word it; ``read``: the reader was shown it; ``at``: when the step stored it.
InboxTradeUpdate.title: InboxTradeUpdate

InboxTradeWaiting.description:
A Trade waiting on the reader, with its ``waiting`` step. ``since``: when it began to wait on them
(``trades.trade_waiting_since``).
InboxTradeWaiting.title: InboxTradeWaiting

InboxUpdate.description:
One update under **Earlier**. ``id`` names it to the read and clear routes. ``other_name``: the collector who took
the step, or for a time-based update the other side. ``loan_kind``, ``loan_state`` and ``role`` (the reader's side)
let the screen word it; ``read``: the reader was shown it. ``kind`` 'withdrawn': a 'cancelled' update on a Loan
its other side withdrew. ``at``: when it happened, the step's time for an event update; for a time-based one, when
it began to apply: the start of the day after the return-by date (overdue), or ``NUDGE_DAYS`` after the request or
offer was sent (nudge_answer) or accepted (nudge_handover).
InboxUpdate.title: InboxUpdate

InboxView.description:
The bell's drawer: the Loans waiting on the reader (each with its ``waiting`` step and ``since``), newest first,
then the updates not cleared, time-based ones first, then event updates newest first; then the Trades waiting on
the reader, the longest waiting last, and the Trade updates not cleared, newest first, at most ``UPDATES``.
InboxView.title: InboxView

InboxWaiting.description:
A Loan waiting on the reader. ``since``: when it began to wait on them, the time of the step it waits for (see
``waiting_since``); the drawer shows it as "3 hours ago" or a date.
InboxWaiting.title: InboxWaiting

InviteCollector.description: Whose Invite Link it is: the Display Name only (the link page never shows a Handle), and how the two stand.
InviteCollector.title: InviteCollector

LastMessage.description: The newest message of a conversation: its sender, the first ``PREVIEW`` code points and its time.
LastMessage.title: LastMessage

LentCard.description: Copies of one Card Edition out with one Friend on one Loan: the Lent out entry's row.
LentCard.title: LentCard

LentOut.description: Every copy the collector lent and hasn't had back, by borrower and then card order; ``copies`` sums them.
LentOut.title: LentOut

LoanCard.description:
One line of a Loan: a Card Edition, the copies asked for and the copies promised ("0" before acceptance and for a
line the lender left out), and those written off (#257).
LoanCard.title: LoanCard

LoanLabel.description: Copies of a line's Card Edition in this Deck that one borrower's Loans take: the borrower's Display Name.
LoanLabel.title: LoanLabel

LoanParty.description:
The other side of a Loan. ``collector_id`` addresses a new request ("Edit and resend") and is never shown; it
and ``handle`` are None once the collector deleted their account, and ``display_name`` is the name they had.
LoanParty.title: LoanParty

LoanPickPlace.description:
Where the lender takes copies of one Edition from: one of their own Locations (``name``), or Unsorted when the
Location was deleted (``location_id`` None). ``short``: copies the Location no longer holds for this pick (the pick
is out of date when above "0"). Once handed over, where the copies came from and go back to.
LoanPickPlace.title: LoanPickPlace

LoanSide.description:
One side's own view of a Loan. The borrower's: ``deck``, the Deck the cards go to (None for Unsorted). The
lender's: ``can_promise`` while the request is unanswered, ``picks``, the Loan Pick List, once accepted, and
``suggested``, the Pick List **Use suggested picks** makes, when a pick is out of date (else empty). The
borrower's ``awaiting_choice`` (#257): where the written-off copies awaiting their choice are.
LoanSide.title: LoanSide

LoanView.description:
A Loan as one side reads it. ``role``: the reader is the lender or the borrower. ``closed_by``: who declined,
withdrew or cancelled, 'you' or 'them'. ``actions``: the steps the reader may take now. ``revision``: send it back
with a step.
LoanView.title: LoanView

LoansView.description:
The Loans tab: every open Loan and the newest closed ones, newest first; ``needs_you`` counts the Loans that
need the reader (the tab's badge, #259).
LoansView.title: LoansView

LocationForTradeResult.description: ``for_trade`` and ``for_trade_by`` as the tree read now reports them for this Location.
LocationForTradeResult.title: LocationForTradeResult

MatchedProduct.description: The TCGCSV product a card-number match named (owner screens only).
MatchedProduct.title: MatchedProduct

Message.description: One message. ``from`` is 'you' for the reader's own and 'them' for the other collector's.
Message.title: Message

MissingCardPrefill.description:
What a Not found line's Missing cards link fills in on the existing report form (``missing_cards.ReportInput``):
a Missing Printing with the pasted English name and number. The pasted code goes into ``set_id`` only when a code
table maps it (``set_codes.tsv``, or ``import_aliases.tsv`` and its rules): that TCGdex set ID, with the number
those rules give (``PR-SW 281`` is ``swshp`` ``SWSH281``). Otherwise the code goes into ``set_name`` and the note,
never into ``set_id``: a manual Printing keyed by an unmapped code is one no code table can reach. Each value is cut
to the report form's limit.
MissingCardPrefill.title: MissingCardPrefill

MoveBorrowed.description: Moves ``quantity`` of one Loan's Borrowed Copies of a card from one of the collector's Locations to another.
MoveBorrowed.title: MoveBorrowed

NearbyMatchRow.description:
One nearby collector's discovery row (Trading #300). Never carries a user id or a Handle, and the band is the
only sign of distance. ``more_you_get`` and ``more_you_give``: the cards past the ones carried, on each side.
NearbyMatchRow.title: NearbyMatchRow

NearbyMatches.description:
Near you: ``status`` is the viewer's own discovery status and ``radius_mi`` their own search radius; ``rows`` is
empty unless ``status`` is ``on``. Never carries a user id or a Handle.
NearbyMatches.title: NearbyMatches

OfferedCopies.description: Copies of one Holding the lender selected: its Location and Card Edition.
OfferedCopies.title: OfferedCopies

OwnTradeList.description:
The collector's own Trade List. ``locations``: every Location a card sits in, in tree order (siblings by name,
case ignored); ``cards``: in card order (name, set, collector number). Both empty when nothing is offered.
OwnTradeList.title: OwnTradeList

OwnTradeSide.description:
The reader's own side of a Trade. ``picks``: their Trade Pick List while their copies are promised (empty when
they give nothing, once they confirmed the swap, and once the Trade closed). ``suggested``: the Pick List **Use
suggested picks** makes, when a pick is out of date, else empty. ``deck_switches``: the Deck switches Confirm swap
offers for the cards they get (Trading #279); non-empty only while the Trade is accepted, they haven't confirmed
the swap and they get cards.
OwnTradeSide.title: OwnTradeSide

PendingReturn.description:
The Loan's return one side has confirmed and the other hasn't (#255): who started it, its copies, and which
sides confirmed it.
PendingReturn.title: PendingReturn

PriceImportRun.description: The newest finished price import (owner only; collector responses never carry it).
PriceImportRun.title: PriceImportRun

disclaimer.default: Basic deck checks only. Format legality, including rotation and banned cards, is reported by the advisory format checks.
disclaimer.title: Disclaimer

PublicInvite.description: The signed-out Invite Link page: the Display Name and nothing else.
PublicInvite.title: PublicInvite

disclaimer.default: Advisory format checks: a result is not a guarantee of tournament legality. Missing rules or card data makes a result unknown, never legal.
disclaimer.title: Disclaimer

PublishedEditionPrice.description: One frozen Edition's price: the exact per-copy amount of its quote, or null when it has none. No age.
PublishedEditionPrice.title: PublishedEditionPrice

ReportCollector.description:
Report the collector with this trader id (which also Blocks them). Source ``trade`` needs ``trade_id``; the
other sources must not carry one. ``note`` is optional plain text.
ReportCollector.title: ReportCollector

ReportDecided.description: What a decision left the report as.
ReportDecided.title: ReportDecided

ReportDecision.description: The owner's decision on an open report (owner screens only).
ReportDecision.title: ReportDecision

ReportParty.description:
One side of a report (owner screens only; may carry user ids, Handles and times). ``user_id`` is null once the
account is deleted; the name and Handle are kept.
ReportParty.title: ReportParty

ReportResult.description: The only thing a Report answers.
ReportResult.title: ReportResult

ReportedAccount.description: The reported collector's account now (owner screens only).
ReportedAccount.title: ReportedAccount

RestoreCollector.description: Reverse a removal from open discovery or a suspension (owner screens only).
RestoreCollector.title: RestoreCollector

SeenNotices.description: Notices the reader was shown (#256); those not showing now are ignored.
SeenNotices.title: SeenNotices

SendBorrowRequest.description: A Borrow Request to a Friend (``lender_id``, a ``collector_id`` the Friends list or a Friend read gave).
SendBorrowRequest.title: SendBorrowRequest

SendLendOffer.description:
A Lend Offer to a Friend (``borrower_id``, a ``collector_id`` the Friends list gave) of the copies the lender
selected in their Collection (#258).
SendLendOffer.title: SendLendOffer

SendTradeProposal.description:
A Trade Proposal. Exactly one of ``recipient_id`` (a Friend's user id, as before) and ``recipient_trader_id``
(any collector in reach) names the recipient; neither or both is 422 RECIPIENT_REQUIRED.
SendTradeProposal.title: SendTradeProposal

SetDiscovery.description: Changes to the caller's setting. A field that is None or absent keeps the stored value.
SetDiscovery.title: SetDiscovery

SideValue.description:
One side's estimated total. ``display_total``: the rounded total for 'priced' and 'empty' ("$0.00"), else None.
``priced_copies``: None only for 'incomplete'. Partial coverage is 'priced' with fewer priced copies.
SideValue.title: SideValue

SnapshotCard.description: One card one side gives, as the snapshot names it.
SnapshotCard.title: SnapshotCard

SnapshotMessage.description: One message of the snapshot (owner screens only).
SnapshotMessage.title: SnapshotMessage

SnapshotTrade.description:
One Trade of the pair as the snapshot kept it (also the shape of ``trade_report_trade.facts``). Owner screens
only. ``ended_by_report``: the Report's Block cancelled it.
SnapshotTrade.title: SnapshotTrade

StartReturn.description: A return of some of the copies out from the caller's side (#255).
StartReturn.title: StartReturn

SwapHint.description: A Want List line's Swap hint: "↻ You own a playable version (PAL 254) × 1".
SwapHint.title: SwapHint

SwitchedDeck.description:
A Deck one Confirm swap switched: the Deck List revision the switch produced, and the totals the Deck List
changes batch sets to undo it (``STALE_DECK_LIST`` once the list moves).
SwitchedDeck.title: SwitchedDeck

TimelineItem.description:
One item of a conversation: a message or a Trade round's card (the Trade as it stands now). ``cursor`` names the
item for ``before`` and for ``read``.
TimelineItem.title: TimelineItem

TradeCard.description: One Card Edition one side gives, with how many copies.
TradeCard.title: TradeCard

TradeCardMatches.description:
Ask to trade: every Friend's Trade List copies of the Printing's Editions, by Friend (Display Name, then Handle,
case ignored) then in card order. Friends with none are absent.
TradeCardMatches.title: TradeCardMatches

TradeCardOffer.description:
One Friend's Trade List copies of one Edition of the Card Printing asked about (Ask to trade). ``collector_id``
addresses the Friend in commands and is never shown.
TradeCardOffer.title: TradeCardOffer

TradeCardSearch.description:
Card search: the viewer's Friends who have the card, then collectors near them. ``status`` is the viewer's own
discovery status; ``near`` is empty unless it is ``on``. Never carries a user id or a Handle.
TradeCardSearch.title: TradeCardSearch

TradeCash.description: Cash recorded with the Trade, in US cents, and who pays it. The app never handles money (Trading #277).
TradeCash.title: TradeCash

TradeListCard.description:
One Card Edition on the collector's Trade List. ``copies``: the copies they offer now. ``places``: where those
copies sit, in tree order, adding up to ``copies``.
TradeListCard.title: TradeListCard

TradeListLocation.description:
One of the collector's own Locations that holds cards on their Trade List. ``path``: the names from the top of
the tree down to this one. ``hidden``: hidden from Friends, by itself or by a Location above it; its cards are on
the Trade List all the same.
TradeListLocation.title: TradeListLocation

TradeListPlace.description: Copies of one card on offer from one of the collector's own For trade Locations (``TradeListLocation.id``).
TradeListPlace.title: TradeListPlace

TradeMatchCard.description:
One card on one side of a discovery row. ``copies``: how many the giving side offers now. ``need``: how many the
receiving side wants in total; ``want_list_need``: the part their Want List needs ("6 wanted (2 for Decks)").
``origin``: which parts are above zero. ``accepts_as``: on the cards the viewer would get only, the narrowest way one
of the viewer's wants takes this card; null on the cards they would give.
TradeMatchCard.title: TradeMatchCard

TradeMatchRow.description:
One Friend's discovery row. ``collector_id`` addresses the Friend in commands and is never shown, and
``trader_id`` is the Friend's address on the trader routes and in the builder; never shown. ``match`` is
null only on the per-Friend read, when nothing matches now. ``more_you_get`` and ``more_you_give``: the cards past
the ones carried, on each side (always 0 on the per-Friend read). ``completed_trades``: the Friend's completed Trades
(Trading #298), always a number for a Friend.
TradeMatchRow.title: TradeMatchRow

TradeMatches.description:
Discovery: one row per Friend who matches, in the order the module docstring gives. ``has_friends`` is false
when the viewer has no Friends, so the page can say that matching needs Friends.
TradeMatches.title: TradeMatches

TradeParty.description:
The other side of the Trade, as the reader may see them (Trading #299, spec "Identity").

``friend``: the other has a profile and is the reader's Friend now (an accepted friendship, no Block). Only then are
``collector_id`` and ``handle`` set; for anyone else they are None, so ``collector_id is None`` no longer means the
account is deleted. ``trader_id``: the other's address on the trader routes and in the builder, None once that
account is deleted; never shown. ``available``: the other is in the reader's reach now (a Friend, a shared
conversation or nearby in open discovery, with no Block and no suspension on either side). The name is kept. Not
available reads the same for a Block, a suspension and a deletion, apart from ``trader_id`` and the name.
``open_to_cash_offers``: their own setting (``/api/social/trade-settings``, Trading #277), False when not available.
``completed_trades``: how many Trades they have completed (``completed_trades``), None when not available.
``trader_id``, ``friend``, ``available`` and ``completed_trades`` have defaults so a stored replay from before they
existed still validates.
TradeParty.title: TradeParty

TradePickPlace.description:
Where the reader takes copies of one Card Edition they give from: one of their own Locations (``name``), or
Unsorted when the Location was deleted (``location_id`` None), as the Loan Pick List names it. ``short``: copies
that Location no longer holds for this pick (the pick is out of date when above "0").
TradePickPlace.title: TradePickPlace

TradeReportDetail.description:
One report with its snapshot, never the live conversation (owner screens only; may carry user ids, Handles and
times).
TradeReportDetail.title: TradeReportDetail

TradeReportList.description:
One page of the queue, newest first (owner screens only). ``open_count``: every open report, whatever the
filter.
TradeReportList.title: TradeReportList

TradeReportRow.description:
One report in the queue (owner screens only; may carry user ids, Handles and times). ``reported_count``: every
report naming the reported collector, this one included (1 when the account is deleted).
TradeReportRow.title: TradeReportRow

TradeSettings.description:
The collector's own trading settings. ``open_to_cash_offers``: Friends may send them a Trade Proposal in which
one side gives only cash (Trading #277); off by default.
TradeSettings.title: TradeSettings

TradeView.description:
One Trade Proposal or Trade as the reader sees it. ``you_give`` and ``you_get`` are the reader's side and the
other side, in the order they were listed. Never a pick, a destination, a Location or a Deck. ``conversation_id``:
the pair's conversation (Trading #298), None for a Trade of a pair that has none; it defaults to None so a stored
replay from before it existed still validates.
TradeView.title: TradeView

TradeWantLine.description:
One Trade Wants line: an exact Card Edition and the copies wanted, with the display data a Want List line
carries.
TradeWantLine.title: TradeWantLine

TraderMatchRow.description:
The discovery row of one collector in reach, with every card (Trading #299). Never carries a user id or a Handle.
``match`` is null when nothing matches now; ``band`` is null unless both are in open discovery. The proposal builder
reads it for Friends and strangers alike.
TraderMatchRow.title: TraderMatchRow

TraderTradeList.description:
One page of the Trade List of a collector in reach. Never carries a user id or a Handle. ``band`` is null unless
both are in open discovery.
TraderTradeList.title: TraderTradeList

TraderView.description:
One collector in reach, by trader id (Trading #299). Never carries a user id or a Handle. ``band`` is null unless
both are in open discovery, and when they are unavailable; ``completed_trades`` is null only when ``status`` is
'unavailable' (it is the real count for 'open' and 'you_blocked'); ``open_to_cash_offers`` is false unless
``status`` is 'open'. ``add_friend`` (Trading #304) is the Friend code's
``add_friend_state``: null unless the two have a Trade both confirmed, are not Friends and are in reach, and null
while the viewer's own pending request was sent by Handle (a Trade cannot withdraw it), and null
whenever ``status`` is not 'open'.
TraderView.title: TraderView

TradesView.description:
The Trades list: open Trades newest first, then the newest closed ones. ``needs_you``: how many wait on the
reader.
TradesView.title: TradesView

TreeLocation.description:
A tree row with the copies stored directly in it: the sum of its Holdings' quantities as a
decimal string, "0" for Organizational Locations and empty leaves. ``hidden``: the collector hid it
from Friends; ``hidden_by``: the nearest Location above it the collector hid, which hides it too
(social network #249). ``for_trade``: its cards are offered for trade, because the collector marked it
or a Location above it (Trading #267); unlike ``hidden`` it is the effective answer, not only the
collector's own mark. ``for_trade_by``: the nearest marked Location above it, or None. A Deck is never
For trade, even inside a marked Location: False and None. Only the tree read carries these; stored
command answers keep ``TreeNode``.
TreeLocation.title: TreeLocation

WantListDeck.description: One Deck, for the page's Deck chips.
WantListDeck.title: WantListDeck

WantListLine.description:
One Deck List line that still needs copies. ``held + borrowed + spare + other_decks + lent + need ==
quantity``.
WantListLine.title: WantListLine

WantListLineCost.description: One section line: its ``need`` copies at the Edition's price.
WantListLineCost.title: WantListLineCost

WantListMatches.description:
Friends' cards for the Want List in scope: only the cards with at least one Friend's copy, in Edition id order.
``has_friends`` is false when the viewer has no Friends, so the page can leave Get from Friends out.
WantListMatches.title: WantListMatches

WantListRowCost.description: One combined-total row: the card's need across the shown Decks (the sum, or the largest need).
WantListRowCost.title: WantListRowCost

WantedCard.description: The Friends' copies that match one card of the Want List's combined total (``edition_id`` is that card).
WantedCard.title: WantedCard

WillAcceptChoice.description: A widened Will accept choice; an Edition with none is this exact card.
WillAcceptChoice.title: WillAcceptChoice

WriteOff.description: The lender writes off some of the copies out (#257). Final: there is no Undo.
WriteOff.title: WriteOff

WrittenOffChoice.description:
The borrower's choice for the written-off copies they hold (#257): ``keep`` them as their own or ``remove``
them. ``places``: where those copies are, as ``LoanSide.awaiting_choice`` lists them.
WrittenOffChoice.title: WrittenOffChoice

get.description: Printings with open reports, and manual Printings that have no correction yet, by Printing ID.

post.description: Ask for more information or reject. Neither changes any attribute.

schema.title: Response Printing History Api Admin Card Attributes  Printing Id  History Get

get.description: The evidence of a Printing's Card Identity, for finding the identity of a Printing.
Manually approved Printings in no Reprint Group, by Printing ID, except replaced ones.
``as_of`` (YYYY-MM-DD) is the day the groups' legality is for; today in UTC by default.
Decisions about this identity's groups, and identity merges into or out of it, newest first.

schema.title: Response Identity History Api Admin Card Identities  Identity Id  History Get

post.description: Ask for more information or reject. Neither changes any target state, so no code is needed.

schema.title: Response Target History Api Admin Catalog Metadata  Kind   Target Id  History Get
Response Reviews Api Admin Catalog Reviews Get
Response Review Editions Api Admin Catalog Reviews  Review Id  Editions Get
Response Rules Api Admin Catalog Rules Get

post.description:
Reverses a removal from open discovery (the collector switches discovery on again themselves) or a suspension
(which never switches discovery on or lifts a removal). 404 COLLECTOR_NOT_FOUND, 409 NOTHING_TO_RESTORE.

schema.title: Response Review Queue Api Admin Missing Card Reports Get

get.description:
One page of reports with this status, newest first, 50 a page. ``before`` is the previous page's
``next_before``; a bad one is 422 INVALID_CURSOR.

One report with its snapshot, the reported collector's other reports and moderation events, and their account
now. Reads only the report-owned rows.

post.description:
The owner's decision on an open report: 404 REPORT_NOT_FOUND, 409 REPORT_DECIDED, and 409
REPORTED_ACCOUNT_GONE for removal or suspension once the account is deleted. Repeats are idempotent: removing a
removed collector keeps the first removal time, suspending a suspended one moves nothing; the report is decided
either way.

schema.title: Response My Reports Api Catalog Attribute Reports Get
Response Replacements Api Catalog Edition Replacements Get
Response My Reports Api Catalog Metadata Reports Get

get.description:
Every set in the active catalog, once each, for Catalog's set picker: A–Z by name, each with the era and release
date the last import stored (the picker groups by them).

post.description:
Reads and matches the file (or the paste, #234) and stores it as the collector's open import draft, replacing any
other. Refuses IMPORT_RATE_LIMITED (429) before reading when this collector has started MAX_STARTS_PER_DAY drafts
in the last 24 hours, and again when it stores the draft, so two starts at once can't both pass the limit. A
refused start isn't counted.

get.description: The collector's open draft's summary; IMPORT_NOT_FOUND when there is none, or it expired.

post.description:
Applies the changes in order, each to its rows as the earlier ones left them, in one transaction: all or none.
The draft revision advances once, even when nothing differs, and the draft's expiry moves to 24 hours from now.
Refuses NO_CHANGES, INVALID_CHANGE, INVALID_FINISH (a descriptor with no physical facet), INVALID_PICK (a card the
catalog doesn't have, or no longer has), ROW_NOT_FOUND, GROUP_NOT_FOUND, NOT_STORAGE_LEAF (a Location that isn't
this collector's Storage Leaf), IMPORT_NOT_FOUND and STALE_DRAFT. A change touches no
Holding and not the owner revision; a repeated request after a lost response gets STALE_DRAFT, and the review
reloads.

get.description: The rows the filters left out (#231), whatever their reason, in the file's own columns (rows_csv).

The draft's rows in file order after `cursor` (a row number), PAGE_SIZE at a time, with each card's active
Editions.

post.description:
Adds the draft's ready rows to its Storage Leaf in one transaction, all or nothing. Refuses ROWS_NEED_YOU while
any row needs the collector, STALE_DRAFT for another draft revision, and REVIEW_CHANGED (409) when the Storage Leaf
is no longer this collector's, or a ready row's Card Edition is no longer active: those rows first return to Needs
you and the draft revision advances, in a transaction of their own, so the review reloads onto them. A repeated key
or a second save answers the stored result while the receipt lasts (24 hours after the save); an expired draft or
receipt is IMPORT_NOT_FOUND, or REPLAY_OUTCOME_UNAVAILABLE for a key already recorded.

get.description: The draft's skipped rows in the file's own columns (rows_csv).

The owner revision alone: one row, no lock. The workspace reads it when a tab regains focus to
notice changes made elsewhere.

The sets of the cards in All owned or one Storage Leaf, once each, for the workspace Set filter.
Search and filters don't narrow it, so every choice stays offered.

post.description:
Create a Deck with its Target Format and Deck List lines in one transaction (no moment exists in which the Deck
is empty). The name is checked as Create Deck checks it; every Edition must be active, of a Printing that isn't
withdrawn (422 EDITION_UNAVAILABLE), and appear once (422 DUPLICATE_EDITION). An empty list creates an empty Deck.
The response is Create Deck's (the Location node and the inventory revision, which advances once) together with
the Deck List command result (the Deck List, its Target Format and that Format's result), stored once for replay.

put.description:
Set or clear the Deck's cover card (#291). Idempotent and checked against the pick the client last read, not the
Deck List revision, so Deck List edits and Rename are never made stale by it, and nothing is re-evaluated.

post.description:
Set several Deck List lines at once (app redesign #177): each change is one line's new total, and 0 removes it.
Every change applies in one transaction or none does, and the revision advances once, even when nothing differs. A
swap is one batch, and the builder's Undo is the inverse batch at the revision this one answered, so
STALE_DECK_LIST means the list changed in between. Only a new line needs an available Edition; a line whose Edition
was retired can still be changed or removed. Like every Deck List command it never touches a Holding, the inventory
revision or the inventory Undo records. The per-line routes stay.

put.description:
Change the Deck List's Target Format (app redesign #178). A Deck List command like the line edits: revision-checked,
idempotent, it advances the revision (saved results depend on it) and returns the new Format's result. Choosing the
current Target Format is accepted and advances the revision too.

get.description: The Deck List's result in its Target Format, or in the Format ``?format=`` names.

post.description:
Adds every item's copies to one Storage Leaf or Deck, all or nothing, under the owner lock: one owner revision,
and one Inventory Undo record of the ``add`` kind that takes exactly these copies out again. The same key and items
(in any order) replay the result; other items under that key answer IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED. An item that names no
available Card Edition, or would overflow its Holding, refuses the whole batch and names the lowest such Edition.

get.description: The Collection's Borrowed entry: every Borrowed Copy the collector holds, where it is and whose it is.

post.description:
Moves Borrowed Copies between the borrower's own Storage Leaves and Decks, under the borrower's lock, and
advances their revision. No Undo record: Undo never touches a Borrowed Copy. Answers the Borrowed list as it now
stands; the same key replays it. 404 LOCATION_NOT_FOUND for a destination that isn't one of the borrower's Storage
Leaves or Decks, 409 NOT_ENOUGH_BORROWED when the source holds fewer of the Loan's copies.

get.description: The Lent out entry: every copy the collector handed over to an open Loan and hasn't had back or written off.

post.description:
The lender offers a Friend copies from their Collection (**Lend to a Friend…**, #258), reserving them at once
under the lender's own lock: 409 NOT_ENOUGH_COPIES (with ``edition_id`` and ``available``) when a Location has
fewer free copies than selected, or the lender fewer copies of an Edition than all open Loans and this offer
need. Each line is offered and promised in full until the borrower answers. 403 ACCOUNT_SUSPENDED for a suspended
sender, after their lock.

The borrower accepts a Lend Offer in whole or in part (#258): each line at most what was offered (422
MORE_THAN_OFFERED), at least one copy in all (422 NOTHING_PROMISED), and the cards for one of their own Decks (404
DECK_NOT_FOUND) or Unsorted. The copies not taken stop being reserved, last pick first. Both owners are locked.

One side confirms the handover for its own inventory, under its own lock. The lender's **Mark as handed over**
takes the picked copies out of their Locations (refused with 409 PICKS_OUT_OF_DATE while a pick is out of date);
the borrower's **Yes, I have them** puts the promised copies into the Loan's Deck, or Unsorted, as Borrowed Copies.
Neither takes an Undo record.

The lender replaces every out-of-date pick with the suggested one (``LoanSide.suggested``), under their lock.
409 PICKS_UP_TO_DATE when no pick is out of date.

Either side starts a return of copies out from its side, which is its confirmation: its own inventory moves now
(``return_lent`` or ``give_back``). Each line is at most the copies out from the caller's side (409 MORE_THAN_OUT);
a line of 0 is left out (422 NOTHING_RETURNED when all are). Complete at once when the other side's account is
gone.

The other side confirms the pending return for its own inventory, which completes it. Once the other side's
account is gone, the side that started the return finishes it alone: its own inventory already moved when it
started, so finishing moves nothing and only completes the return, and the Loan closes once nothing is out.

A side takes back its own handover confirmation while the other side hasn't confirmed, under its own lock, and
only its own inventory write is reversed: the lender's copies go back to their picks' Locations (Unsorted when one
is gone), the borrower's Borrowed Copies leave. The Loan is accepted again, with its copies reserved.

The lender writes off copies out on the Loan (**Write off…**), under their own lock, once they confirmed the
handover. Each line is at most the copies out, less those a return the borrower confirmed gives back (409
MORE_THAN_OUT); a line of 0 is left out (422 NOTHING_WRITTEN_OFF when all are). Final: no Undo, and no take-back
of the handover after it. The copies leave the lender's Collection; the borrower's rows are untouched.

The borrower's choice for the written-off copies they hold (**I still have it** or **It's gone**), under their
own lock. ``places`` must be exactly ``LoanSide.awaiting_choice`` (409 CHOICE_CHANGED otherwise). Keep turns the
copies into owned Holdings where they sit, with one Undo record per Location, as copies added there; they were
already there, so no Deck List line changes. Remove takes them away, with no Undo.

put.description:
Mark a Location For trade, or not (Trading #267). Any kind but a Deck: a Deck is refused either way (409
DECK_NOT_FOR_TRADE), and one inside a marked Location stays off the Trade List. Un-marking a Location inside a
marked one is refused (409 LOCATION_FOR_TRADE_BY_PARENT with ``for_trade_by``, the nearest marked Location above
it); marking one there is allowed, and it stays For trade when that Location is un-marked. Independent of hiding.
Bumps the Location's version and never the inventory revision, and reserves nothing: nothing the collector counts
changes. Idempotent.

Hide a Location from Friends, or show it again (social network #249). Any kind: an Organizational Location, a
Storage Leaf, a Deck or Unsorted. Showing a Location inside a hidden one is refused (409 LOCATION_HIDDEN_BY_PARENT
with ``hidden_by``, the nearest hidden Location above it); hiding one there is allowed, and it stays hidden when
that Location is shown. Bumps the Location's version and never the inventory revision: nothing the collector counts
changes. Idempotent.

schema.title: Response My Reports Api Missing Card Reports Get

put.description: Change the Display Name. Idempotent; the current name is accepted and changes nothing.

Change the Handle. In order: the format (422 INVALID_HANDLE), reserved names and the filter (422
HANDLE_NOT_ALLOWED), the current Handle (no change) or the same one in another case (always allowed), the 30-day
limit (409 HANDLE_CHANGE_TOO_SOON with ``available_at``), the hourly attempt limit (429 TOO_MANY_HANDLE_TRIES with
``retry_after_minutes``), then whether another collector has it or held it within 30 days (409 HANDLE_TAKEN). An
attempt that reaches the last check is counted even when it is refused. Idempotent.

post.description: Make a new Invite Link: the old link stops working once this answers. Idempotent.

get.description:
The signed-out Invite Link page's one read: the public records store only, never PostgreSQL. An unknown,
replaced or malformed token is 404 INVITE_NOT_FOUND; any query string is 422 INVALID_REQUEST.
The owner's active publications, including those whose Deck was deleted (``deck_id`` null).

post.description:
Adds every item's copies to one Storage Leaf, all or nothing, under the owner lock: one owner revision. The same
key and items (in any order) replay the result; other items or another route under that key answer
IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED. A destination that is gone or not a childless Storage Leaf answers DESTINATION_CHANGED
before any Edition is looked at; EDITIONS_CHANGED lists every Edition that is no longer active.

put.description:
Change the Want List counting setting. Revision-checked and idempotent; choosing the current value is accepted and
advances the revision too, as choosing a Deck's current Target Format does.

post.description:
Unblock from Settings › Privacy: lifts any Block the caller placed, of either kind. An unknown id, or someone
else's, is 404 BLOCK_NOT_FOUND. A retry with the same key replays.

Block a collector: any friendship or Friend Request between the two ends, and the blocked collector isn't told.
Allowed whether or not they blocked the caller.

Unblock a collector the caller blocked. Nothing else comes back: they are not Friends again. It lifts a Block
made by user id and a trader Block of a former Friend (their Handle is already on the Blocked row); asked about
any other trader Block it changes nothing and answers as if there were none.

get.description:
Friends who have this card (#251, the card popup): the Friends' copies of every Edition of the Card Printing,
and under ``reprint_group`` of the other Printings of its Reprint Group too. An unknown Printing has none.

One page of a Friend's Collection: the cards they could lend now. 404 FRIEND_NOT_FOUND unless ``handle`` is one
of the viewer's Friends.

The reader's conversations, newest activity first, 50 a page. ``archived=true`` lists the archived ones; an
archived conversation is visible again once its last activity is newer than the archive time. Writes nothing.

How many visible conversations are unread, and the watermark of everything the shell shows: counts and sums
over the reader's conversations and inbox updates (``Decimal`` sums are hashed as text). It moves on a message, a
Trade step, an inbox update, a Block or Unblock between the pair (``pair_changed``), a suspension of either member
or its lift (``account_changed``), and the reader's own read, archive and unarchive, and not on a rename. Writes
nothing and makes no owner row.

The reader's conversation with the collector who has this trader id. A pair with a conversation answers it. A
collector in reach with none answers an empty one (``id`` null, no items) for the composer. Anyone else, an unknown
trader id and the reader's own are 404 CONVERSATION_NOT_FOUND. Writes nothing.

One conversation and a page of its items, newest first. 404 CONVERSATION_NOT_FOUND for an unknown id and for a
reader who is not a member. Writes nothing.

post.description: Hides the conversation from the reader's list until it has newer activity. Nobody deletes a conversation.

Sends a message to a conversation the reader is a member of. Refusals and order: see the module docstring. A
replay by ``idempotency_key`` answers the stored message and is not counted.

Moves the reader's read marker to the time of the item the cursor names, never back. 422 INVALID_CURSOR for a
malformed cursor, one naming no item of this conversation, or one whose time is not that item's. Writes only the
reader's own member row.
Shows an archived conversation in the reader's list again.

get.description: The caller's own Open discovery setting. Writes nothing and makes no owner row.

put.description:
Switches Open discovery on or off, stores a zip code and sets the radius. Idempotent by value: a body that
changes nothing writes nothing. See the module docstring for the order of the refusals.

post.description:
Send a Friend Request. Within a week of the other collector declining one, it is 409 TRY_LATER. When the two
are already Friends, a request is pending either way or the caller blocked the other collector, nothing changes and
the answer says so. A collector who blocked the caller is 404 COLLECTOR_NOT_FOUND, as an unknown one is. A suspended
sender is 403 ACCOUNT_SUSPENDED (after both owner locks, not counted).
Accept a Friend Request from this collector: the two become Friends. Without one, nothing changes.

Decline a Friend Request from this collector: it is deleted, and the sender isn't told. The sender can't send
another for a week.
Withdraw a Friend Request sent to this collector: it is deleted.
Remove Friend: the friendship ends for both. Without one, nothing changes.

**Clear**: dismisses the updates the drawer showed, which also marks them read. A cleared time-based update
doesn't show again.
Marks the updates the drawer showed read. Marking twice changes nothing.

get.description:
The Invite Link page signed in: who the link belongs to and how the two stand. An unknown or replaced link is 404
INVITE_NOT_FOUND. Not counted as a lookup.

post.description:
Either side cancels an accepted Loan nobody has confirmed a handover for: its copies stop being reserved, so the
lender's revision moves. The lender locks only themself; the borrower locks both. The other side gets a 'cancelled'
update (#259).

The lender says no to a Borrow Request, locking only themself, or the borrower to a Lend Offer, which releases
its copies and locks both (#258). The other side gets a 'declined' update (#259).

The borrower asks for a later return-by date (#256): 422 EXTENSION_NOT_LATER unless it is after the current
one, and INVALID_RETURN_BY for a day before today. Only the Loan row is locked.

The lender approves the borrower's request for more time with one tap (#256); 422 INVALID_RETURN_BY when the
date asked for has passed. The borrower gets a 'return_by_changed' update (#259).
The lender says no to the borrower's request for more time (#256); the date stays.

Records that the reader was shown these notices (#256), so each shows once per side. A notice not showing now
is ignored, so it can still show later. No step: no revision, no key; recording twice changes nothing.

The lender changes or clears the return-by date of an open Loan (#256). Only the Loan row is locked. A date that
changed gives the borrower a 'return_by_changed' update (#259).

The borrower takes back a Borrow Request before it is answered, locking only the Loan row; or the lender a Lend
Offer, which releases its copies under the lender's lock (#258). The other side gets a 'cancelled' update (#259),
which the inbox reads as 'withdrawn' from the Loan's ``closed_reason``.

Find a collector by their exact Handle, ignoring case. A Handle that can't exist is 422 INVALID_HANDLE and isn't
counted. Past the hourly limit it is 429 TOO_MANY_LOOKUPS with ``retry_after_minutes``, and isn't counted. Otherwise
the lookup is counted and answers the collector, or 404 COLLECTOR_NOT_FOUND, raised after the count commits.

Report a collector by trader id; see the module docstring for the order of the checks. Answers 201
``{reported: true}`` whatever state the reported collector is in.

get.description:
Ask to trade (the card popup): each Friend's Trade List copies of each Edition of the Card Printing. An unknown
Printing has none.

Who has one card for trade: ``friends`` (answered whatever the status) and ``near`` (only while the status is
``on``; the candidates are the viewer's radius, up to ``CARD_SEARCH_CANDIDATES``). ``scope`` is ``printing`` (that
Printing's Editions), ``name`` (every Printing of its Card Identity) or ``set`` (the ``name`` Editions within the
picked Printing's set, not every card in the set). An unknown Printing answers empty lists. A suspended viewer has no
copies through the choke point, so gets no Friends. Promised and borrowed copies never appear. No Handle or user id.

One page of a Friend's Trade List: the cards they offer to trade now. 404 FRIEND_NOT_FOUND unless ``handle``
is one of the viewer's Friends. A suspended Friend reads as no Friend here (404 FRIEND_NOT_FOUND); their Collection
stays readable.

Discovery: one row per Friend who has cards the viewer wants or wants cards the viewer has, with at most
``CARDS_PER_SIDE`` cards per side. No prices or values.

Near you: the matching collectors near the viewer who are not Friends, within the radius stored in their
discovery setting. The candidates (at most ``NEAR_CANDIDATES``) are read inside ``discover``'s snapshot; rows are
sorted by kind, band, Display Name and trader id and cut to ``NEAR_ROWS``. Rows are empty, and no Want List is read,
unless the status is ``on``. A Friend never appears. Declared before the per-Friend route so ``near`` is no id.

One Friend's discovery row with every card on both sides, and a null ``match`` when nothing matches now. 404
FRIEND_NOT_FOUND unless ``collector_id`` is one of the viewer's Friends.
The caller's own trading settings. Writes nothing and makes no owner row.

put.description:
Turns Open to cash offers on or off for the caller only (Trading #277). Idempotent by value: no key, no revision,
the last write wins. Moves no inventory revision and counts against no limit.

get.description:
One collector's header by trader id: a pair with a conversation, or anyone the reach rule holds for. 404
COLLECTOR_NOT_FOUND for an unknown trader id, the viewer's own, and a collector out of reach. Writes nothing.

post.description:
Block the collector with this trader id, whatever the reach. An unknown trader id is 404 COLLECTOR_NOT_FOUND,
the caller's own is 409 OWN_ACCOUNT. The blocked collector isn't told.

get.description:
The discovery row of a collector in reach, with every card on both sides and a null ``match`` when nothing
matches now. 404 COLLECTOR_NOT_FOUND unless the reach rule holds.

post.description:
Sends a message to the collector who has this trader id, in the pair's conversation, which it opens when there
is none (the other must then be in reach). An unknown trader id, the reader's own, a conversation that is
not open, and a collector outside reach with no conversation are all 409 COLLECTOR_UNAVAILABLE. After the hourly
limit (429 MESSAGE_RATE_LIMITED), a message that opens the conversation with a collector who is not a Friend is
counted: 429 TOO_MANY_NEW_CONVERSATIONS at 10 in 24 hours. Locks both owners.

get.description:
One page of the Trade List of a collector in reach: the cards they offer to trade now. 404 COLLECTOR_NOT_FOUND
unless the reach rule holds.

post.description:
Unblock the collector with this trader id. It lifts only a Block made by trader id; asked about one made by
user id it changes nothing and answers as if there were none. A pending Friend Request is answered as none.

Offer to become Friends with the other side of a Trade both sides confirmed. Refused in order: 403
ACCOUNT_SUSPENDED, 404 TRADE_NOT_FOUND, 409 TRADE_NOT_SWAPPED, 409 COLLECTOR_UNAVAILABLE (a deleted, blocked or
suspended other, all the same body). Then under both owner locks: the other's pending request is accepted
('friends'); with no friendship a pending request is sent ('request_sent', 409 TRY_LATER within the decline
cool-off); in any other state nothing changes and the relation is answered.

Withdraw the Add as Friend request the caller sent to the other side of this Trade. Refused like adding, except
for suspension: 404 TRADE_NOT_FOUND, 409 TRADE_NOT_SWAPPED, 409 COLLECTOR_UNAVAILABLE. Under the owner locks only
the caller's own pending request that came from a Trade (via_trade) is deleted; a Handle request or any other
state is left as it is, and the current relation is answered.

Either side calls off an accepted Trade nobody has confirmed. It releases both sides' copies in one transaction,
under both sides' locks, and moves the revision of each side that gives cards; the other side gets a 'cancelled'
update that never says why. A proposal (withdraw or decline it) and a Trade either side confirmed are 409
STEP_NOT_ALLOWED.

The recipient turns down a Trade Proposal, whole. It releases the copies the proposer gives, under both sides'
locks, which moves the proposer's revision when they gave cards; the proposer gets a 'declined' update. No
friendship check: unfriending and Blocking close the pair's open Trades first, under the same locks (#274).

The proposer takes back a Trade Proposal nobody has answered. It releases the copies they give, under the
proposer's own lock, which moves their revision when they gave cards; the recipient gets a 'cancelled' update.

get.description:
Friends' cards for the Want List (#251): for each card the Want List still needs, over every Deck or the one in
``deck`` and under the account's counting setting, the Friends' copies it reaches under ``printings``. Its own
read, apart from the Want List's: a Friend's change never moves the Want List's revisions. 404 DECK_NOT_FOUND for a
Deck that isn't the viewer's.
The collector's own Trade Wants and Will accept choices. One snapshot, no lock, no write.

put.description:
Sets the collector's Will accept choice for one Card Edition, wherever it appears on their Want List, whether or
not it is there now; 'edition' (this exact card) removes the choice. A widened choice for an Edition the catalog
doesn't have is 422 EDITION_UNAVAILABLE. Nothing else changes: no revision moves, and no Want List figure.

Sets one Trade Wants line to ``quantity`` copies, or removes it with "0" (removing a line that isn't there
changes nothing). Refused, with nothing changed: 422 INVALID_QUANTITY (not a whole number from 0 to 9999), then for
a new line 422 EDITION_UNAVAILABLE (an Edition that doesn't exist or may not start a line now) and 422
TOO_MANY_LINES (the collector already has 500 lines). An existing line can always be changed or removed.

post.description:
Sends a Trade Proposal to a Friend (by ``recipient_id``) or to any collector in reach (by
``recipient_trader_id``) and reserves the copies the sender gives. Refused before anything is read, in this order:
422 RECIPIENT_REQUIRED (neither or both recipient fields), 409 OWN_ACCOUNT (the user id is the sender's), 422
INVALID_QUANTITY, 422 DUPLICATE_EDITION (one Edition twice on one side), 422 SAME_CARD_BOTH_SIDES, 422
TOO_MANY_LINES, 422 TRADE_HAS_NO_CARDS, 422 INVALID_CASH. Then, after the command begins (a replay answers here):
403 ACCOUNT_SUSPENDED (the sender), 409 COLLECTOR_UNAVAILABLE (an unknown trader id, the sender's own, or a
recipient outside reach; by user id the recipient must be a Friend), checked once before the locks and again under
them, 429 TOO_MANY_NEW_CONVERSATIONS (``retry_after_minutes``) when the send opens a conversation with a collector
who is not a Friend and the sender has started 10 in the last 24 hours, 409 CASH_ONLY_NOT_OPEN
(``side``: the sender's side that gives no cards and pays, when the recipient isn't Open to cash offers), and 409
NOT_TRADEABLE (``edition_id``, ``available`` and ``side``, 'you_give' or 'you_get') for the first line, the
sender's lines first, that asks for more copies than are on that side's Trade List now. Locks both owners and
opens the pair's conversation (attaching their earlier Trades), so the Trade carries it.

get.description:
The collector's own Trade List: every card they offer now, with its copies and the For trade Locations those
copies sit in. One snapshot, no lock, no write.

post.description:
The recipient accepts a Trade Proposal whole, and it becomes a Trade. After ``run_trade_step``'s checks (404
TRADE_NOT_FOUND, 409 TRADE_CHANGED, 409 STEP_NOT_ALLOWED), under the recipient's own lock: 403 ACCOUNT_SUSPENDED
(the recipient), 409 COLLECTOR_UNAVAILABLE once the proposer isn't in their reach (a deleted proposer included),
then 409 NOT_TRADEABLE (``edition_id``, ``available``, ``side`` 'you_give') for the first line they give, in the
order listed, that asks for more copies than are on their Trade List now. Nothing changes on a refusal. The
proposer gets an 'accepted' update.

One side confirms the in-person swap for their own inventory, under their own lock only. After
``run_trade_step``'s checks (404 TRADE_NOT_FOUND, 409 TRADE_CHANGED, 409 STEP_NOT_ALLOWED, so a side confirms once),
and before any write: 409 PICKS_OUT_OF_DATE while a pick of theirs is out of date; for a side that gets cards, 404
LOCATION_NOT_FOUND or 409 UNSORTED_UNAVAILABLE for where they go; then 409 DECK_SWITCH_CHANGED when a Deck switch
they chose is not offered now (``want_list.deck_switch_candidates``, with at most the offered copies). Their
``deck_switches`` are shape-checked before the transaction: 422 INVALID_QUANTITY, 422 DUPLICATE_EDITION, 422
TOO_MANY_LINES. Then the copies they give leave, the copies they get arrive, their revision moves once, the Deck
switches apply as Deck List changes (each switched Deck's Deck List revision advances once for the switch; the
answer's ``switched_decks`` names it and the batch that undoes it), the copies they get beyond their Decks' needs lower their
Trade Wants, and their swap time is set; when the other side already confirmed, the Trade closes as swapped and the
other side gets a 'swapped' update. Nothing changes on a refusal, and nothing undoes the swap.

The recipient counters a waiting Trade Proposal (Trading #278): it closes as 'countered', which frees the copies
its sender gave, and the sender is sent the reply as a new proposal (``countered_from`` the old one), reserving the
copies the counterer gives. Answers the new Trade as the counterer reads it. One transaction, own flow rather than
``run_trade_step``. Refused before anything is read or counted, in a send's order (without OWN_ACCOUNT): 422
INVALID_QUANTITY, DUPLICATE_EDITION, SAME_CARD_BOTH_SIDES, TOO_MANY_LINES, TRADE_HAS_NO_CARDS, INVALID_CASH. Then,
after the command begins (a replay answers the stored view): 404 TRADE_NOT_FOUND for anyone but its two sides; both
owners are locked (ascending) when the caller is the recipient, then the row; 409 TRADE_CHANGED; 409
STEP_NOT_ALLOWED unless 'counter' is allowed; 403 ACCOUNT_SUSPENDED (the counterer); 409 COLLECTOR_UNAVAILABLE (the
sender isn't in the counterer's reach); 409 CASH_ONLY_NOT_OPEN (``side``) for a Counter with
a cash-only side to a sender who isn't Open to cash offers, unless the countered proposal had a cash-only side
itself. The old row closes and its picks go in that close; only then are the caps read (409 NOT_TRADEABLE, the
counterer's lines first), so a Counter may ask for every copy the sender had listed. A refusal rolls everything
back and leaves the original waiting with its picks. Nothing is stored for the inbox: the new proposal is the
sender's waiting answer. A side's revision moves only when its cards are released (the sender, if they gave cards)
or reserved (the counterer, if the Counter gives cards).

The side that gives cards replaces every out-of-date pick of theirs with the suggested one
(``OwnTradeSide.suggested``), under their own lock; only their picks change and only their revision moves. After
``run_trade_step``'s checks (404 TRADE_NOT_FOUND, 409 TRADE_CHANGED, 409 STEP_NOT_ALLOWED for a side that gives
nothing or no longer reserves), 409 PICKS_UP_TO_DATE when no pick is out of date.

get.description:
The reader's own Trade Pick List with their own Location names, which picks are out of date and what Use
suggested picks would make. One snapshot, no lock, no write. 404 TRADE_NOT_FOUND for anyone who isn't one of the
Trade's two sides, as for a Trade that doesn't exist. ``deck_switches`` (Trading #279) are what Confirm swap would
offer now, only while the Trade is accepted, the reader hasn't confirmed and they get cards; ``destination_id``: the
Deck the cards would arrive in, offering that Deck only (anything else reads as no Deck destination).
